brief: A Windows app that relays the messages and media of a Discord channel to OBS and desktop widgets, with moderation. The old radar icon was a near-stock symbol that faded at taskbar size and only existed in white on black.
criteria: Success: says what Relay does without a chat bubble or Twitch purple, reads at 16 px in the taskbar and the tray, works in one colour, keeps Relay green.

concepts.name: The card that leaves the frame
concepts.idea: A message card from Discord breaks out of the stream frame: what Relay does, in one shape.
rationale: Shows the product's output, a message landing on stream, instead of the category's chat bubbles and radar waves
Relay green on the card, the panel's own accent colour, so the app and the logo match
A simplified cut keeps the frame and the card readable at 16 px in the taskbar and the tray
Built on a 4-unit grid: one 24-unit band, radii 40 and 16, a 12-unit gap where the card crosses the frame

recommendation: Use the symbol alone for the app, tray and favicon; the horizontal lockup in the panel header, README and website.
next_steps: Replace the app icon (src-tauri/icons) and the panel logo
Use the horizontal lockup on the website and in the README
Run a trademark search before public launch
